text:
leo-finance: Quick heads-up  new Q2 budget autoflagging + invoice cutoff rules live now. Please review before submitting spend this quarter: https://redwood.company/finance/q2-close :spiral_calendar:

procurement-bot: POLICY BULLETIN by @leo-finance
- Any requests that push a cost center >10% of its remaining Q2 budget will be autoflagged for FP&A review.
- Invoice cutoff for Q2 close: invoices must be submitted by 2026-06-25 11:59pm PT to be included in Q2.
- Capitalizable purchases: submit capex justification and tag `CAPEX` in the form. Finance will follow capitalization rules.

amy-product: Clarifying q: we have a $14k infra appliance that was quoted last week. If we submit the PO now, will it be in Q2?

leo-finance: If invoice arrives by cutoff and vendor invoice date is <= 2026-06-25, yes. PO creation alone doesn't guarantee close; invoice must be uploaded.

ben-sales: For customer billable pass-throughs, do we need to code differently?

procurement-bot: Use `GL-7001` for pass-throughs and attach the customer invoice. These are excluded from budget autoflags but still count to cost center spend.

amy-product: For capital vs expense, is $5k threshold still the rule?

leo-finance: Capitalization policy remains: items >= $10k considered capex (exceptions with CFO sign-off). Small tooling < $10k treated expense. We'll publish examples in the doc.

cfo-rachel: Quick ask: FP&A will triage autoflags within 48 hours. If your request is time-sensitive, include a brief exec note and tag `urgent-close` in the form so we can prioritize for quarter-end.

leo-finance: Also: email AP mailbox for vendor invoices if you can't upload them to the procure portal. Put the cost center and PO number in the subject line to avoid delays.

procurement-bot: New commands:
- `/procure upload-invoice` to attach vendor invoices to an existing PO
- `/procure capex` to start capitalization workflow

ben-sales: Thanks. One more: are virtual cards allowed for purchases that need capital treatment initially?

leo-finance: Prefer vendor invoice for capex. If you must use a virtual card, finance will reclassify but may need a vendor statement. Avoid VC for capex when possible.

amy-product: Noted. Can FP&A publish a short checklist for quarter-end invoice packing? Will help teams avoid misses.

leo-finance: Yes  we'll post a checklist and run a 20-min Q&A tomorrow at 9am PT. Recording will be in #all-hands. Drop specific scenarios here or DM me.
